name: emberbsd-user
description: Agent skills for EmberBSD users: OS installation onto boards, desktop VMs and USB-cabled phones, applications, device diagnostics, personal Ports and GitHub workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Use EmberBSD devices and maintain your personal Ports.
interface.longDescription: Install EmberBSD onto supported boards, virtual machines and USB-cabled phones; then operate your device, configure applications, maintain personal source changes across upstream updates, and publish checked patches to the selected personal repository using available tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $emberbsd-install to install EmberBSD on my device and confirm the first boot.
Use $emberbsd-user-guide to complete my EmberBSD user task and verify the result.
